messages:
Harper Lee: quick UX flag from smoke tests — the floating action (FAB) on Projects is getting visually covered by toasts on narrow widths (375px). The FAB shadow also looks clipped. Screenshot attached.
Sasha Ivanov: repro'd. We bumped compact padding earlier and the fab is positioned with bottom: 24px; toasts appear at bottom: 16px so they collide. Also the fab's label truncates to "Cr..." on some locales.
Priya Patel: product note: prefer short FAB labels ("New") for narrow breakpoints but keep full label on desktop. Also want toast CTAs to be single-word verbs where possible.
Omar Diaz: implementation idea: don't change global spacing tokens; introduce component-level vars: --cmp-fab-pad-x and --cmp-fab-pad-y and a semantic depth token system: depth.fab, depth.toast, depth.modal (mapped to z-index). That way apps can map depth -> z numbers at runtime.
Harper Lee: feels safer than changing raw z-values everywhere. Also request: increase FAB hit target to 56px on touch devices to reduce accidental taps near toolbar.
Sasha Ivanov: dev concern: increasing hit target might shift layout. Suggest making the FAB visually 40px but with invisible padding to reach 56px via padding + hit area. Will prototype.
Priya Patel: a11y: ensure FAB has aria-label when shortened, and Preserve long label for screen readers (aria-label=\"Create project\"). Also keep focus-visible outline high contrast.
a11y-bot: checklist: icon-only or short-label FAB must have aria-label; focus-visible must meet contrast token; toasts should use aria-live and role appropriately; ensure focusable toast actions are reachable via keyboard and preserve tab order. Run SR smoke tests.
Omar Diaz: quick CSS prototype (pushed to branch):
```css
:root { --cmp-fab-pad-x: 14px; --cmp-fab-pad-y: 12px; --depth-fab: var(--depth-map-fab, 1400); --depth-toast: var(--depth-map-toast, 1300); }
.fab { padding: calc((56px - 40px) / 2) var(--cmp-fab-pad-x); min-width: 40px; min-height: 40px; border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-floating); z-index: var(--depth-fab); }
.toast { position: fixed; right: 16px; bottom: 16px; z-index: var(--depth-toast); }
@media (max-width: 420px) { .toast-stack { display:flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-end; }
  .fab--label-short { width: 40px; }
}
```
Omar Diaz: note: we're using an invisible padding trick so the visual size remains compact but hit target is 56px. Will include screenshots.
Harper Lee: copy nit: tooltips still show token names in a few spots ("spacing.compact"). Please show user-facing copy like "New project".
Sasha Ivanov: will sweep tooltip content. Also will add migration doc explaining depth.* semantics vs numeric z-index.
Priya Patel: for mobile stacking prefer newest toast at top so quick dismiss is visible, but avoid covering FAB. Let's test both orders with product and QA.
a11y-bot: mobile stacking heuristic: if toast contains action that requires user input, keep it above FAB and ensure keyboard users can reach it; otherwise stack to avoid covering primary CTAs. Document in component README.
Harper Lee: scheduling a 20-min sync after standup to finalize token names + copy. /remind me in 20
Omar Diaz: branch: github.com/redwood-inference/ui/compare/fab-depth-hitarea — I'll post visual diffs shortly.
Priya Patel: thanks all. small ask: include light/dark screenshots and a short changelog entry listing the aria/focus checks.
a11y-bot: Reminder: add SR smoke test in CI for toast announcements and FAB aria-labels.
